resources.string: Extends the usable start area for the system Back gesture using transparent edge zones. The service does not read screen content and does not use the network.
Adds a narrow transparent zone just inside the existing Back edge. The phone\'s native Back zone remains untouched.
Detected native zone: %1$d px (%2$.1f dp). The extra zone starts just inside it.
Follows the system language by default. On Android 13 and later you can choose a separate app language.
dp (protects the Home gesture and keyboard corner)
Test mode: show the extra zones
Use the phone appearance automatically, or force a light or dark Magic Swipe interface.
Manual checks contact the public GitHub Releases API. Automatic checks are disabled by default and run at most once every 24 hours after you explicitly enable them.

Magic Swipe will contact GitHub automatically at most once every 24 hours while the settings screen is opened. If you choose to download an APK from GitHub, that download is outside F-Droid and bypasses F-Droid\'s build verification. Automatic checks are optional and can be disabled at any time.
The Update button opens the official APK on GitHub. Installing that APK is outside F-Droid and bypasses F-Droid\'s build verification.
Magic Swipe v%1$s is up to date.
Could not check GitHub for updates.
Could not open the update download.

Privacy: no analytics and no screen-content access. INTERNET is used only for user-initiated or explicitly enabled update checks against the public GitHub Releases API. Automatic checks are disabled by default. The AccessibilityService itself does not use the network.
